args.summary: Deploy v2.3.1 (most recent release) began failing health checks in all production regions with an elevated error rate of 18%. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production per deployment history. Post-rollback verification: all regions healthy on v2.3.0, error rate reduced to 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Incident:** checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy
- **Found:** v2.3.1 deployed to all production regions, unhealthy, 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release with a "healthy" production status in the deployment history. (No change-manager approval needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.)
2. **Verified recovery:** all regions now running v2.3.0, healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the issue, the rollback, and verification; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 (and its staging rc) will need investigation before the next deploy attempt.
